relationships.subject: salicylalazine
relationships.evidence_quote: In a nutshell, SAZ achieved significant anti-arthritic benefits, most likely via the modulation of the TLR4/NLRP3/GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis pathway, lowering oxidative stress, and improvement of clinical findings.

relationships.subject: salicylalazine
relationships.evidence_quote: Also with SAZ, there was a substantial (p < 0.001) decrease in the expression of pyroptotic mediators.

key_findings: Salicylalazine reduced paw edema, flexion pain and oxidative stress in formaldehyde and CFA arthritis models
SAZ decreased expression of TLR4, MyD88, NFκB, NLRP3, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, caspase-1 and GSDMD
